prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, a chaotic restaurant kitchen buzzes with energy. On the far left stands a tall chef in a pristine white uniform, his arms crossed tightly over his chest as he observes the chaos with a stern expression. Next to him, slightly toward the center, a frantic line cook in a stained blue apron is frantically chopping vegetables on a wooden board, sweat beads visible on his forehead. In the center foreground, a large stainless steel pot sits on a burner, steam rising in thick, swirling clouds that obscure the background slightly. To the right of the pot, a young waitress in a pink dress leans forward eagerly, her hand extended to receive a plate from the line cook. Behind her, near the right edge, an elderly dishwasher in a gray cap looks at the waitress with a gentle smile, holding a clean glass up to the light. Perched atop a stack of crates in the upper right corner, a small orange cat watches the scene with wide, curious eyes, its tail twitching slowly. The chef on the left is pointing sharply at the line cook, indicating a missed order, while the line cook is handing a steaming plate to the waitress in the pink dress. There is no electronic equipment like tablets or digital screens visible anywhere in the kitchen, maintaining a traditional culinary atmosphere despite the modern anime aesthetic.
